name: Crico's Pizza & Subs
description: Crico's Pizza and Subs in Gulf Shores, AL, is a beloved local eatery renowned for its delicious pizzas and mouthwatering subs. Nestled in the heart of Gulf Shores, this cozy establishment offers a welcoming atmosphere where patrons can enjoy freshly prepared meals with friends and family. From traditional pepperoni pizzas to specialty pies loaded with gourmet toppings, Crico's caters to every pizza lover's cravings. Their subs are equally tantalizing, with a variety of options ranging from classic Italian combos to hearty meatball subs. With friendly service and quality ingredients, Crico's Pizza and Subs is a must-visit destination for both locals and tourists craving authentic and satisfying meal on the Alabama Gulf Coast.
